summary: The lip change clears fA-1 cleanly and nothing else regressed. The 16 mm roll-in lip now carries the sidewall colour, so the beige ring round each window is gone. The lip's R-B now matches the cool wall (−5 to −13 against the wall's −10). b_jClose row 280: lip was 197/195/192 and 198/195/191 (R-B +5/+7), now 194/197/201 and 196/198/202 (−7/−6); wall 195/198/206. b_jClose row 150: lip went from R-B 0..+4 to −9..−13. Row 450: the right-hand lip went from +3..+9 to −5..−10. s09 row 250: lip was 181/179/178 and 190/189/187, now 178/181/188 and 187/191/196. s09 row 450: lip went from +2/+5/+10 to −10/−8/−4. b_dadoY2: lip was 204/202/201, now 201/204/211 (R-B −10), between the tub (−22) and the wall (−9). No new seam or step: the sill and bezel bottom junction columns (b_jClose col 300 y470-555, s09 col 540 y480-555) are pixel-identical to head. The cream bezel stays at R-B +5..+8 below the sill (b_jClose), as intended. The F bowl hue is unchanged: the s09 tub is 209/219/233 in both renders. Y/PY bezels are unchanged: the ra_pyWin row 350 frame and tub are identical. ra_carpetY and ra_door2floor are 0 % changed, b_doorWin and s06 are 0.00 %, and s07 is 0.16 %. q12's 6.8 % is accounted for. 21k bright changed pixels are cloud and sky motion. 15k dark pixels are the near reveal lip, which went from 90/93/96 to 88/95/105, slightly cooler with no level change; the bezel stays charcoal (fA-2, lighting). In the montages (scratchpad/fa2/) the q03, s09 and b_jClose bezels now read as one cool white surface, as in c_27316. With the only medium item gone, the shell is back at the w18 level, with the lining tones closer to the photos than w18. The remaining items are all low: three lighting items and the carried shell list. 8.5.
